page.content:
Aang's sky bison and the Gaang's flying home.

How Appa connects

  • Faction: The Gaang — Appa carries the Gaang.
  • Character: Aang — Appa is Aang's sky bison and animal guide.

What is Appa?

Appa is the six-legged sky bison who carries the Gaang, Aang's animal guide, stolen and recovered in one of the series' longest hunts.

Key threads lead to The Gaang and Aang.
